email_body:
Hi ${name},

To ensure accurate and reliable results for your Bio-AI Health Report, please follow the pre-test guidelines below:

Fasting:
A 10 - 12 hour fasting period is recommended before the test.

If fasting is not possible, you may have a very light, non-greasy breakfast such as:
*   Plain idli, plain dosa, upma, or poha
*   Black tea or black coffee
*   Tender coconut water
*   A small fruit such as apple or guava
*   4 - 5 plain almonds or walnuts
*   Plenty of water

Please avoid before the test:
*   Fried items such as medu vada, parathas, or buttered toast
*   Sugary beverages or juices
*   Milk or dairy-based drinks
*   Bananas, mangoes, or other high-sugar fruits

Consuming high-fat or high-sugar foods before the test can significantly alter lipid profile, blood sugar levels, and other metabolic markers, which may impact the accuracy of your Bio-AI Health Report. Also please complete your Health Assessment before your test, as it is essential for generating your Bio-AI report.

Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to supporting you on your preventive health journey.

Warm regards,
Team SuperShyft

Thank you for trusting us and taking the first step towards preventive health, your profile is now ready !

Ready to get started?
Please visit: https://app.supershyft.com/
Log in using your registered mobile number and Verify via OTP for secure access

To unlock your personalized Bio-AI Health Report, please complete your Health Assessment. These inputs enable us to generate more accurate, personalized, and actionable insights for your Bio-AI report.

If you need any assistance, please feel free to reach out, we're happy to help. Looking forward to supporting you on your health journey.

Warm regards,
Team Supershyft
